label: Microbiome fermentation → SCFA pool
name: Colon fermentation base unit (skeleton)
description: Provisional base unit for LAW-026 SCFA energy recovery. Shape is solid (fermentable cargo → SCFA → host can absorb). Magnitudes are a soft prior band only — FLOW may demo ~2 kcal/g fermentable; do not treat as law-locked.

science.summary: Fermentable fiber/RS → acetate, propionate, butyrate. Yield and SCFA mix depend on substrate type/form and microbiome. Fermentable CHO reaching the colon is not energy-free.
science.gap: No primary human balance study locked as single kcal/g in this unit; use magnitude band only. Do not promote engine-only coefficients as LAW-SPEC.
science.shape_claim: LAW-026 shape solid: fermentable colon substrate → SCFA → host absorption possible; bulk/gas pathways exist.

mechanisms.label: Microbial fermentation to SCFA
mechanisms.notes: Join engine FiberRSModel.simulate_fermentation as FLOW only; host ME uses prior band below

laws.note: energy recovery exists (shape solid); magnitude = provisional band, not locked

energy_kcal_per_g_fermentable.basis: Secondary synthesis band (e.g. Livesey-type ~1.5–2.5; FAO conventional dietary fibre ME often ~8 kJ/g ≈ 2.0 kcal/g). Not a single FLOW coefficient. RS/microbiome heterogeneity (EV-041) forbids point lock.
energy_kcal_per_g_fermentable.note: Use mid for demos only; claim_tiers.scfa remains flow until locked elsewhere

bounds_and_conditions.risks_of_deviation: Treating mid (2.0) or any single sim coeff as law overstates certainty; interindividual and substrate heterogeneity are large (EV-041).
bounds_and_conditions.conditions_text: Requires fermentable cargo reaching colon (LAW-025/017). Yield and SCFA mix depend on substrate form and community.
